sign_convention: All values recorded with the sign as printed (brackets = negative). Values taken from notes are printed unsigned and recorded as positive.
income_statement_title: STATEMENT OF FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE for the year ended 30 June 2005 - Wesfarmers Limited and its controlled entities (CONSOLIDATED 2005 column)

income_statement_lines.label: Share of net profits of associates
Profit from ordinary activities before income tax expense
Income tax (expense) benefit relating to ordinary activities
Profit from ordinary activities after income tax expense
Net (gain) loss attributable to outside equity interests
Net profit attributable to members of the parent entity

revenue.label: Revenues from ordinary activities
revenue.note: AGAAP total revenue. Note 3 (pdf 68, p66) components: Revenue from the sale of goods 6,858,310; Revenue from insurance premiums 1,069,033; Revenue from other services 98,977; Proceeds on sale of non-current assets 35,817 (gross proceeds, AGAAP); Dividends other corporations 1,487; Interest received 19 + 52,757; Rent received 2,025; Other income 71,964. Includes interest, asset-sale proceeds and insurance premiums, so it is broader than sales.

other_income.note: Not presented separately under AGAAP. Note 3 line 'Other income' 71,964 ($000, pdf 68) is a component of 'Revenues from ordinary activities' and is NOT additional to revenue.

cost_of_sales.label: Cost of goods sold
cost_of_sales.note: Note 4 'Expenses and other gains/losses', first line of 'Expenses'. Group also has insurance (premium revenue 1,069,033); insurance claims/underwriting costs are not shown as a separate functional line in note 4.

raw_materials_and_inventory.note: By-function presentation; no by-nature materials line. The unaudited 'Creating wealth and adding value' table (pdf 7, p5) prints 'Total cost of materials, goods and services and other external costs' $m 5,818, which is broader than raw materials and inventory.

employee_benefits_expense.label: to employees as salaries, wages and other benefits
employee_benefits_expense.note: NOT from the audited accounts: from the unaudited 'Creating wealth and adding value' (value-added) table in the front section, rounded to $m. AGAAP notes do not print total employee benefits expense; note 4 prints only 'Provision charged against profits - Employee benefits' 69,956 ($000), which is a provision charge, not total labour cost.

depreciation_and_amortisation.label: Depreciation and amortisation (total of note 4 sub-items)
depreciation_and_amortisation.note: Printed subtotal in note 4: buildings 10,616; plant and equipment 161,423; leasehold improvements 3,011; mineral exploration and development 12,053; goodwill 90,430. Goodwill amortisation (90,430) is also shown as a separate line on the face; the remaining D&A sits inside 'Expenses from ordinary activities'. Segment note (pdf 67, p65) prints consolidated 'Depreciation and amortisation of property, plant and equipment' (187,103).

impairment.label: Write down of non-current assets - Property, plant and equipment
impairment.note: Note 4 disclosure item (within expenses from ordinary activities). Bad and doubtful debts 1,887 also printed in note 4.

selling_general_admin_lines.label: Cost of rural services business sold

ebit.note: No consolidated EBIT line in the statement of financial performance. Alternatives printed, not equivalent: segment note (pdf 67, p65) 'Earnings before interest paid, tax (EBIT) and corporate overheads' consolidated 1,035,417 $000 (before consolidation adjustment (4,523) and corporate overheads (47,753)); financial summary (pdf 7, p5) 'Net profit before interest and tax' $m 949, which does not equal PBT + borrowing expenses, apparently a net-interest definition.

finance_costs.label: Borrowing expenses
finance_costs.note: Note 4: interest paid 100,916 + other borrowing costs 3,504, less borrowing expenses capitalised (1,583) = total borrowing costs expensed 102,837.

profit_before_tax.label: Profit from ordinary activities before income tax expense

income_tax_expense.label: Income tax (expense) benefit relating to ordinary activities

net_profit_after_tax.label: Net profit attributable to members of the parent entity
net_profit_after_tax.note: Attributable to members. Total (before outside equity interests): 'Profit from ordinary activities after income tax expense' 618,874 (pdf 56). No discontinued operations line under AGAAP; FY2004 comparative includes sale of rural services (Landmark).

ppe_net.label: Property, plant and equipment
ppe_net.note: Statement of financial position, non-current assets (note 14).

intangible_assets.label: Intangible assets
intangible_assets.note: INCLUDES GOODWILL. Note 15 (pdf 78, p76): Trade names at cost 41,600; Goodwill at cost 1,728,215 less provision for amortisation (393,304) = 1,334,911.

employees.label: EMPLOYEES*
employees.note: Rounded headcount ('* As at 30 June 2005'). Corporate citizenship section (pdf 50, printed p48): 'At the end of June 2005, almost 30,000 people worked for Wesfarmers with about 90 per cent of employees located in Australia'. Not FTE.

australian_revenue_share.note: No geographic revenue split printed. Note 2 states segments operate 'predominantly in Australia'; activities focused in Australia and New Zealand.

checks.income_statement_identity: Revenues from ordinary activities 8,190,389 - Expenses from ordinary activities 7,156,621 - Amortisation of goodwill 90,430 - Borrowing expenses 102,837 + Share of net profits of associates 39,803 = 880,304 vs printed PBT 880,304

issues: Pre-IFRS AGAAP statement of financial performance: 'Revenues from ordinary activities' includes gross proceeds on sale of non-current assets (35,817), interest and insurance premiums; not directly comparable to AIFRS revenue.

Expenses presented by function in note 4; no total employee benefits expense in the audited accounts. Employee figure ($950m) is taken from the unaudited value-added table and is in $m, unlike the other fields ($000).
Goodwill amortised under AGAAP (90,430 shown separately on the face); intangible assets include goodwill.
Report has an AIFRS transition note (note 1(w)) with expected adjustments; numbers recorded are as originally reported under AGAAP.
Diversified group incl. insurance (Lumley/WFI): insurance underwriting expenses are embedded in functional lines, so COGS/revenue markups mix retail, industrial and insurance activity.
